column1: # EmulatorJS, fetched at build time and never committed.
# One archive holding the loader and every core: 290 MB compressed, 283 MB of
# cores once unpacked. Pinned by URL and verified by SHA-256, exactly like
# assets/fonts — a repository is a poor place for a third of a gigabyte of
# somebody else's WebAssembly, and a hash in a text file gets everyone the same
# GPL-3.0. See LICENSES.md; the licence file travels in the archive and is
# Fetched from the release, not from a CDN. This is a LAN service that has to
# work with the internet down, and a CDN reference would be the only thing in
# the app that phones out while somebody is playing.
